tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250thugs rje chen po yang gsang bla med las/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs dbang gi chu bo bzhugs so// 1$0000300hrīḥ ye shes skye med snang ba mtha' yas dang*// ma 'gags longs sku thugs rje chen po dang// tshad med sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i byin gyis rlobs// dbyings gzhi ngang nyid shes rab na bza' dkar// lam gyi cho 'phrul gsang ba'i ye shes mo// 'bras bu gar dbang bde chen rgya mtsho la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i byin gyis rlobs// dkyil 'khor ngo bo'i dbang phyug lo tsā ba// rang bzhin yongs la mngon snang zab gter bdag /thugs rje gang 'dul lung zin chos bdag la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i byin gyis rlobs// byams pa chen po rgyal ba'i cho 'phrul gyi// snying rjes bstan 'gro bu bzhin skyong mdzad pa'i// byang sems brgyud rim rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i byin gyis rlobs// yang gsang bla med thugs rje chen po yi// lam gyi smin grol bskyed rdzogs 'bras bu yi// bcud 'dzin bka' yi srung ma dang bcas la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i byin gyis rlobs// sngon sbyang las 'phro can la skal bzang gis// yang gsang bla med lam bzang bskyed rdzogs kyis// bsgrub cing grub pa'i 'bras bu mngon 'gyur zhing*// rang gzhan don gnyis myur du lhun grub shog /
ces skal ldan kun bzang ting 'dzin gyis bskul ba don yod pa'i phyir/ sgyu 'phrul rdo rje klong gsal snying pos shar shing sgo gangs kyi ra bar sbyar ba'o// maṅga laṃ// //
